name: Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce
author: Nilesh Kanzariya

sections.description:
Tired of updating WooCommerce orders to “Completed” every day?
Let automation handle it for you.

Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce completes orders automatically based on product type, payment method, customer role & global rules — no coding needed.

Works perfectly for physical, digital, virtual & downloadable products.

Why Store Owners Love This Plugin ❤️

  • ⚡ Zero manual work — orders auto-complete after payment
  • 🔥 NEW: Custom Order Status Support
  • 🎯 Smart conditions: payment gateways, product types, user roles
  • 💸 Improve buyer experience — instant product delivery
  • 🌍 Works with PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna & more
  • 🏁 Safe: COD/Bank Transfer excluded by default
  • 🚀 Optimized for large stores handling 20,000–30,000+ orders
  • 🤖 Lightweight — runs only when needed, no performance hit

Perfect for:

✔ Digital product stores (eBooks, Music, PDFs)
✔ LMS, memberships, subscriptions
✔ Stores wanting automation & time-saving
✔ High-volume WooCommerce sellers

Free Features

🔹 Automation & Rules
– Autocomplete orders after successful payment
– Based on payment method & customer role
– Global enable/disable toggle

🔹 Product Type Compatibility
– Supports: Simple, Grouped, Variable, Virtual, Virtual + Downloadable

🔹 Status & Display Options
– 🆕 Custom Order Status support
– Show payment method on order page
– Thank You Page custom message

🔹 Performance & Compatibility
– Optimized for 20k–30k+ order stores
– Works with all major gateways
– Lightweight & safe for live websites

Premium Features

Unlock PRO for advanced automation power:

✨ Product-specific autocomplete rules
✨ Target product types (Variable-only / Subscription-only)
✨ Product picker for selective automation
✨ Category-based rules
✨ Region-based gateway control
✨ Admin/Customer email notifications
✨ Import/Export settings
✨ Advanced automation logic

👉 Upgrade to PRO → https://nilsatwara.github.io/autocomplete-woocommerce-orders/

Notes

Supported: PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Square, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo
Not Supported: COD / Bank Transfer / Check (Manual approval recommended)

Summary

A simple, powerful solution to automate WooCommerce order completion.
Trusted by store owners — optimized for large shops processing 20k+ orders.

Save time. Reduce clicks. Automate your store.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/autocomplete-for-woo-orders/
  2. Activate through Plugins menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Smart Autocomplete
  4. Enable automation rules
  5. Done — orders now complete automatically! 🎉
sections.faq:
Does it autocomplete all orders?

Yes — all paid orders are auto-completed if product type is supported.
(Custom conditions available in PRO)

Does it work with COD or unpaid methods?

No. COD/Bank Transfer/Check are excluded for safety.

Is it safe for subscription or membership sites?

Yes — PRO allows Subscription-only automation.

Will emails continue to send?

Yes. WooCommerce emails work normally.
(PRO adds extra email options)

Will it slow down large stores?

No. It’s optimized and tested on 20,000–30,000+ order stores.

Which gateways are supported?

All payment gateways confirming successful payment including Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo & more.
